scientific_integrity: Elementary all-order proof with independent finite exhaustive checks. No independent external validation or audit performed.
scientific_limitations: The sharp odd-girth and parity statements cover all finite nonempty trees and exactly three named colours; they do not cover cyclic base graphs, extra colours, or higher-dimensional homology. The edge count is an existing chromatic-pairs specialization, not a novel claim. Indexed-priority search is not proof of absolute first discovery.
title: Universal sharp odd girth of tree three-colouring reconfiguration graphs
